why: Text of the pages a person sees when an agent sends them a link.
title: A request from your agent
confirm_heading: Your agent needs you to confirm one thing.
ask_heading: Your agent has a question for you.
ends: This link works once and ends in {minutes}.
unexpected: Didn't expect this? Say no, and nothing changes.
done_confirmed: Done. Your agent has been told. You can close this page.
done_declined: You said no. Your agent has been told. You can close this page.
done_answered: Sent. Your agent has your answer. You can close this page.
ended: It was already used, or its time ran out. If you still want this done, ask your agent for a new link.
unavailable: We couldn't reach the service just now. Nothing changed. Please try again in a moment.
need_answer: Please type an answer, or choose Say no.
private: Please leave out private information. Your agent will see what you type.
